```yaml
name: E2E Portals
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust Toolchain
        uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@v1

      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Build tavern
        run: cargo build --package tavern --release

      - name: Build imixv2
        run: cargo build --package imixv2 --release

      - name: Build socks5 proxy
        run: cargo build --package socks5 --release

      - name: Start infrastructure
        run: |
          ./target/release/tavern &
          TAVERN_PID=$!
          sleep 5
          
          ./target/release/imixv2 &
          IMIX_PID=$!
          sleep 5
          
          echo "Tavern PID: $TAVERN_PID"
          echo "Imix PID: $IMIX_PID"
          echo "TAVERN_PID=$TAVERN_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "IMIX_PID=$IMIX_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Playwright
        run: npm install -g playwright

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/tests/portal.spec.ts

      - name: Get Portal ID from GraphQL
        id: get_portal_id
        run: |
          PORTAL_ID=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/graphql \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"query":"query { portals { id } }"}' | jq -r '.data.portals[0].id')
          echo "PORTAL_ID=$PORTAL_ID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Start SOCKS5 proxy
        run: |
          ./target/release/socks5 --portal-id ${{ env.PORTAL_ID }} &
          SOCKS5_PID=$!
          echo "SOCKS5_PID=$SOCKS5_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          sleep 2

      - name: Start mock HTTP server
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8000 &
          HTTP_SERVER_PID=$!
          echo "HTTP_SERVER_PID=$HTTP_SERVER_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          sleep 2

      - name: Verify data integrity
        run: |
          # Create test file
          echo "Test content for data integrity verification" > test_file.txt
          
          # Calculate original checksum
          ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM=$(md5sum test_file.txt | cut -d' ' -f1)
          
          # Transfer through proxy
          curl --socks5-hostname localhost:1080 http://localhost:8000/test_file.txt -o downloaded_file.txt
          
          # Calculate downloaded checksum
          DOWNLOADED_CHECKSUM=$(md5sum downloaded_file.txt | cut -d' ' -f1)
          
          # Compare checksums
          if [ "$ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM" = "$DOWNLOADED_CHECKSUM" ]; then
            echo "Data integrity verified successfully"
          else
            echo "Checksum mismatch!"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          kill ${{ env.TAVERN_PID }} 2>/dev/null || true
          kill ${{ env.IMIX_PID }} 2>/dev/null || true
          kill ${{ env.SOCKS5_PID }} 2>/dev/null || true
          kill ${{ env.HTTP_SERVER_PID }} 2>/dev/null || true
```
